item_name: Rothco Deluxe Low Profile Army Veteran Cap
item_short_desc: Showcase your dedication with Rothco’s Deluxe Low Profile Veteran Cap. This baseball cap features raised embroidered "ARMY" and "Veteran" symbols, boldly representing your commitment and service. Constructed from durable brushed cotton twill, it ensures lasting comfort and wear. The rugged hat design includes 6 ventilation holes that provide enhanced breathability, making it ideal for outdoor activities. An internal sweatband effectively manages perspiration, keeping you cool and dry throughout the day.
description: Showcase your dedication with Rothco’s Deluxe Low Profile Veteran Cap. This baseball cap features raised embroidered "ARMY" and "Veteran" symbols, boldly representing your commitment and service. Constructed from durable brushed cotton twill, it ensures lasting comfort and wear. The rugged hat design includes 6 ventilation holes that provide enhanced breathability, making it ideal for outdoor activities. An internal sweatband effectively manages perspiration, keeping you cool and dry throughout the day. Additionally, the sandwich brim highlights your branch of service with a woven label, adding a touch of pride to your headgear. Whether you're tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, Rothco's headwear collection offers unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from active-duty personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
